description: This file defines a custom exception class SQLInjectionException used for handling SQL Injection related errors in the Fineract project. It extends a core platform exception and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: SQLInjectionException
classes.description: An exception class used to signal detection of SQL injection attempts, extending PlatformApiDataValidationException.

methods.name: SQLInjectionException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a standard error message and code.

methods.name: SQLInjectionException(SQLException e)
methods.description: Constructor that includes the caught SQLException as the cause for the exception.
